# The subject. One comparison, which is the whole of what it decides, so the
# table in tools/mutation_sample.py derives exactly one mutant from this file
# and the pair below is about that one mutant rather than about a population.
#
# The same bytes are in the neighbour directory. What differs there is the
# suite, because what a mutation run decides is whether the SUITE noticed, and
# a pair that changed the subject would be testing something else.


def admits(value: int) -> bool:
    return value < 10
